# aj auth

Log in, log out, and switch between Jira accounts.


## `aj auth login`

Check an API token against the site, store it securely and make it the active account.

Logging in again with the same site and email replaces its token.

```text
aj auth login [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-s`, `--site` `TEXT` |  | Jira site, e.g. your-team.atlassian.net. |
| `-e`, `--email` `TEXT` |  | Your Atlassian account email. |
| `-t`, `--token` `TEXT` |  | API token. Prefer --token-stdin or the prompt. |
| `--token-stdin` |  | Read the API token from standard input. |


## `aj auth logout`

Forget an account and delete its API token.

```text
aj auth logout [ACCOUNT] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ACCOUNT` |  | Account to remove (email@site, email or site). Default: active. |
| `--all` |  | Log out of every account. |


## `aj auth status`

List saved accounts; the active one is marked ●.

```text
aj auth status [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--check` |  | Also verify the active token with Jira. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `aj auth switch`

Make another saved account the active one (asks which when there are several).

```text
aj auth switch [ACCOUNT] [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ACCOUNT` |  | Account to activate (email@site, email or site). |
| `-s`, `--site` `TEXT` |  | Pick by site. |
| `-e`, `--email` `TEXT` |  | Pick by email. |
